name: Four of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today is about rest, recovery, and mental or emotional pause. It suggests stepping back from stress to restore inner balance and clarity.
card_advice: Take time to rest and recharge. Avoid overthinking or pushing forward too aggressively. Healing and reflection will bring better results than action right now.

upright.general: The Four of Swords represents rest after conflict, mental recovery, and the need for solitude. It suggests stepping away from stress or difficult situations to regain clarity and strength. This card emphasizes healing through stillness and reflection.
upright.in_love: In love, it can indicate a pause in the relationship, emotional distance, or the need for space to think and heal. It may also represent recovery after emotional conflict.
upright.in_situation: In situations, it suggests taking a break, slowing down, and avoiding decisions until clarity returns. It is a time for reflection rather than action.

reversed.short: Restlessness, burnout, recovery ending, avoidance of rest.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Four of Swords indicates recovery from a difficult period or, alternatively, inability to rest due to anxiety or pressure. It can also suggest burnout if rest is ignored.
reversed.in_love: In relationships, it may show renewed communication after a break or continued emotional exhaustion due to unresolved issues.
reversed.in_situation: In situations, it warns against pushing too hard without recovery. It may also indicate that it is time to return to action after a period of rest.

major.01: New beginnings after rest and reflection.
major.04: Authority or structure requiring rest and recovery.
major.10: End of stress cycle and recovery phase.
major.13: Transformation through letting go and rest.
major.15: Breaking free from stress or toxic patterns.
major.16: Sudden need for recovery after chaos.

swords.10: End of mental overload through recovery.
